evidence.command:
python - <<'PY'
import csv, json, re
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/home/xu/project/loop/DeepScientist/quests/001')
rows=list(csv.DictReader((root/'experiments/stage10/08_meta/SELECTOR_METRICS.csv').open(newline='',encoding='utf-8')))
by={r['selector_name']:r for r in rows}
meta=json.loads((root/'experiments/stage10/08_meta/STAGE10_META_ANALYSIS.json').read_text())
script=(root/'experiments/stage10/scripts/stage10_meta_analysis.py').read_text()
contenders=re.findall(r"['\"]([^'\"]+)['\"]",re.search(r"contender_names\s*=\s*\[(.*?)\]",script,re.S).group(1))
def f(n,k): return float(by[n][k])
status={n:{'regret_at3':f(n,'macro_normalized_regret_at3'),'cost_to_contain':f(n,'mean_cost_to_contain_winner'),'beats_regret':by[n]['beats_cfc_only_on_macro_normalized_regret_at3']=='True','beats_cost':by[n]['beats_cfc_only_on_mean_cost_to_contain_winner']=='True'} for n in contenders}
out={'rows':len(rows),'configured_contenders':contenders,'orbitrepair_in_configured_contenders':'OrbitRepair-Proxy' in contenders,'orbitrepair_proxy':{'top3':int(by['OrbitRepair-Proxy']['top3_containments']),'models':int(by['OrbitRepair-Proxy']['model_count']),'regret_at3':f('OrbitRepair-Proxy','macro_normalized_regret_at3'),'cost_to_contain':f('OrbitRepair-Proxy','mean_cost_to_contain_winner'),'beats_regret':by['OrbitRepair-Proxy']['beats_cfc_only_on_macro_normalized_regret_at3']=='True','beats_cost':by['OrbitRepair-Proxy']['beats_cfc_only_on_mean_cost_to_contain_winner']=='True'},'cfc_only':{'top3':int(by['CFC-only']['top3_containments']),'models':int(by['CFC-only']['model_count']),'regret_at3':f('CFC-only','macro_normalized_regret_at3'),'cost_to_contain':f('CFC-only','mean_cost_to_contain_winner')},'contender_status':status,'configured_contenders_any_beat_both':any(v['beats_regret'] and v['beats_cost'] for v in status.values()),'ce_selection_gate_passed':meta['gate_results']['ce_selection_gate_passed'],'closed_reasons':meta['gate_results']['closed_reasons']}
print(json.dumps(out,sort_keys=True))
PY

assertions.text: Read-only S10-13 evidence supports the bounded CE-selector claim: OrbitRepair-Proxy is numerically best in SELECTOR_METRICS.csv (top3 containment 5/6, macro normalized regret@3=0.0058068827370489386, mean cost-to-contain=4.833333333333333), but it is not in the configured CE-gate contender set. The configured LoopCert/Pareto/blend contenders all improve macro regret@3 versus CFC-only but fail the mean cost-to-contain criterion, so ce_selection_gate_passed=false and Stage10 should not claim CE-selector success over CFC-only.
